taskScenario: A first-time user tries to reset a forgotten password from the login screen.
conceptText: The login screen has an email field, a password field, a 'Forgot password?' link, and a primary 'Log in' button. Clicking 'Forgot password?' opens a modal asking for an email address, with a 'Send reset link' button and a 'Cancel' link. After clicking 'Send reset link', the modal simply closes with no confirmation message shown.
